items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
items.claim: Moses stretched his hand over the sea; the sea returned to normal at morning, and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians fleeing into the sea.
items.action: stretched forth hand, returned to strength, overthrew
items.place: over the sea, midst of the sea
